'''Glearius Parvil''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was a sympathizer of the Sith and wished to break ties with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in order to open relations with the Sith Empire instead.

{{GameLSmechanics}}
Several members of a movement known as the [[True Republic]] sought to sabotage Parvil by stealing an important parcel from him to ensure that his ideals did not come to pass and so they sent a Republican individual to do the job.

The individual upon trying to steal the parcel was caught by a [[Unidentified Senate page|Senate page]] who did not approve of the individual's actions against the Republic's regulations and then demanded that the individual return the parcel in exchange for a fake parcel to lead the True Republic movement astray and maintain the democracy of the Republic.
{{Endgame}}

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Parvil is only mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' quest "The Politics of Dissent." The player can also choose to sabotage Parvil which will reveal that his Senate Page also hoped for the senator's plan to succeed.
